answer: In an economy of AI agents, each identity must lock scarce collateral before it can trade, then pass unpredictable cross-checks with unrelated agents. A coordinator samples claims at the summit, using a lantern rule that hides which audit comes next, while a dune of linked accounts cannot share one bond without exposing correlation. Proven collusion burns the deposit and erases reputation, so a Sybil attacker must fund many costly bonds and risk losing them for every fabricated identity.
